title: Early/snap Assembly and constitutional-era gate
finding: Current ordinary cycle is term-derived 2030. Article 99 early path can overtake it. Do not mint a snap date or assume the same dissolution mechanism across pre/post-2023 constitutional eras.
release_condition: A new official decree and applicable constitutional text, dated to the event.

title: Presidential selection / runoff / founding years
finding: Current President/VP is popular joint ticket. 2006/2011/2016/2021 rounds transcribed; 1992/1996/2001 archives and the 1989–1991 transition remain incomplete. No indirect transition selection is represented as a popular vote.
release_condition: CIK archived decisions and protocols for each missing round; date-specific transition act.

title: Submunicipal_scope policy hold
finding: Retain 3,067 P identities: 35 district and 3,032 village mayor rows. Their result data do not confer production acceptance or 2027 eligibility.
release_condition: Justin policy change plus a dated official 2027-or-later eligible-office roster.

title: Градец 2015 unresolved qualification change
finding: BG-SLV11-b88d0d4475-V retains six first-round and two unresolved runoff observations. No 2015 selected completed event, fabricated withdrawal, correction, or replacement election.
release_condition: Original competent election/qualification/court decision linking the precise candidate and stage.

title: Municipal roster / consolidations / same-territory changes
finding: All P 530 accepted IDs retained. NSI confirms 265 municipalities as of end-2025. Full dated 2026 name/code comparison and older municipal reform mapping remain incomplete; no adds/removes or guessed successor links.
release_condition: Official EKATTE changes and electoral registers, including both old and new unit identity.

title: Stefan Stambolovo / Gradina settlement rename
finding: NSI identifies same official settlement code 17467 and a December 2025 rename. Keep the possible P village-office match held and original label lossless; do not mint a second office.
release_condition: Authoritative office-to-settlement crosswalk and dated eligibility evidence; no successor edge needed solely for same-code rename.

title: EP era and incomplete losing-list votes
finding: Five election years retained. 2007 selected winners only, BSP votes untranscribed; 2009–2024 EP summary percentages/seats, raw votes absent. Initial allocation is distinct from treaty or later membership composition.
release_condition: CIK certified full national vote vectors and dated EP seat-allocation/composition acts.

title: 1989–1991 / Grand National Assembly
finding: Sourced seventh Grand National Assembly is a distinct historical body, combined 1990 election allocation. No kingdom or People’s Republic office is equated with today’s ordinary Assembly; no guessed successor edge.
release_condition: Dated constituting and termination acts before any added historical identity or edge.

title: Published aggregate inconsistencies
finding: Five event vectors disagree with retrieved headline aggregates; all numeric observations retained, review flagged. April 2021 independent-candidate denominator also requires scope review.
release_condition: Original signed protocols and correction decisions; no arithmetic imputation.

title: Certification / annex / raw-source access
finding: Many CIK pages were indexed and extractable but direct downloads returned 403. Saved text hashes are extraction hashes, not raw HTML/PDF hashes. P local histories include third-party public CIK republication caveats.
release_condition: Original national/municipal certification documents and raw bytes when accessible.

title: Earlier parliamentary partiality
finding: 1997 date-only; 2001/2005 summaries omit losing lists; 2009/2013/2014 seats-only; 2017 seats not transcribed. Missing fields stay null.
release_condition: CIK/Parliament archival full tables and certified seat allocations.

title: Annulled / corrected / repeat / replacement
finding: 27 October 2024 court-corrected result is a result revision, not a new 2025 election. 2009–2010 court/composition changes remain separately described. P unresolved local outcomes are not promoted; any genuine repeat ballot requires its own sourced event.
release_condition: Court order, amended certificate and explicit repeat/replacement call as separate source records.

title: No invented regional elected layer
finding: Regional governor office is appointed under Article 143; NUTS regions are not a reason to create elected offices. Regional elected count remains zero.
release_condition: A new law establishing a distinct popular elected body would be required.

title: Calendar beyond global alert horizon
finding: All ordinary families remain on country calendar even if next ordinary elections are beyond about 18 months; 2029/2030 are recorded without fabricated days.
release_condition: Official calls update precision; they do not determine whether the family exists.

title: English/Bulgarian constitutional translation conflict
finding: Article 64(3) Bulgarian says before expiry; retrieved English says after. Calendar follows Bulgarian text, with no inferred precise expiry-day election.
release_condition: Use the promulgated Bulgarian text for operative dates; retain translation conflict.

title: Latest-law version and mayor-era gate
finding: Current direct municipal mayor ballots are established by Election Code and electoral practice. Article 139 permits statutory direct/indirect arrangements; current mode must not be back-projected across every earlier era or municipality class.
release_condition: Dated Election Code/local-government amendments and original contests for each historical extension.
